notes.title: Happy Holidays from the Mission Impawsible team!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139039/0189a3b94cbfcdc96331fb25cda8540254146a22.png[/img]

On behalf of Dog Man, the Supa Buddies and Team Mindscape, we want to wish everyone happy holidays! This year has been paws-itively amazing so we can't wait for 2025! 🎄🎉

If you haven't experienced Dog Man: Mission Impawsible yet, click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118020/Dog_Man_Mission_Impawsible_Demo/][u]here[/u][/url] to begin your free demo mission. 

Good luck and a happy New Year!

notes.title: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible - Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cAATQDBCvjI;full][/previewyoutube]
Calling all Supa Buddies for our most impawsible mission yet!

The key to the city has fallen into the hands of a supa bad guy, unlocking all the prison doors and releasing many evildoers. 

Join Dog Man, Li'l Petey, and 80-HD while they explore 50 unique levels inspired by familiar locations, such as City Hall, the Giant Marshmallow Factory, and the Cops Building.

Happy launch day everybody!

notes.title: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible @ Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Dog Man and the Supa Buddies are joining Steam Next Fest this week! You can play our free demo, which is also available on PlayStation 5 and Nintento Switch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139039/ed8fd68f14e321b4b0af31b78f7d7c4551bc352b.png[/img]
Dog Man: Mission Impawsible is coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X|S on December 6, 2024.

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118020/Dog_Man_Mission_Impawsible_Demo/][u]here[/u][/url] to begin your mission. Good luck!

notes.title: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible Launches December 6th
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=trMpi90sSFM;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready for an epic adventure! We're excited to announce that Dog Man: Mission Impawsible will be available December 6, 2024 on Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X|S.

Help Dog Man and his friends chase down the supa bad guys! Embark on an exciting journey across 50 unique levels spanning 5 diverse worlds, all in pursuit of the thief who stole the key to the city. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139039/eceae976e25275b6d008cc804bdc492437fb6584.jpg[/img]
Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies, each equipped with special abilities and gadgets like Rocket Boots, Retractable Claws, and Dirt-Proof Pants. Together, conquer challenging obstacles and take down powerful, recognizable bosses!

To prepare for your most impawisible mission yet, a brand-new demo will be released soon.
